Operating hours vary by location; please check the BIFF Ticket Box schedule for each venue.
On the Opening day, October 6, only tickets for Next-day general screenings are available at the BIFF Outdoor Ticket Box of Busan Cinema Center.
Community BIFF screenings can only be booked at the MEGABOX Busan Theater 4F Ticket Box.
Recommends using Chrome for online (PC/mobile) bookings.
If the booking page does not appear, please check the pop-up blocking settings on your browser.
Multiple sessions or simultaneous logins with the same account are restricted.
Booking across multiple devices, browsers, or tabs within the same browser is not permitted.
※Ticket booking may not work properly on tablet devices.

If traffic is heavy, you will be given a queue number and automatically admitted in order. You can book up to 2 tickets per screening code. Booking for a different screening code will require re-entering the queue.
If booking details cannot be found, contact the BIFF Call Center(1666-9177).

venueRules.source: 2026 官方 Ticket Catalogue PDF p20「Theater Regulations」

items.text: As a rule, each screening begins on schedule.  Entry is allowed until 15 minutes after the screening starts. Please note that once a screening begins, reserved seats may not be guaranteed.
Admission to the theater is available 15 minutes before the screening begins. It is subject to change depending on the situation on-site. Please follow the guidance of the staff and volunteers.

You must present a valid ticket (mobile or paper) at the theater entrance. Screenshots of mobile tickets or reservation confirmation messages (such as emails or text messages) will not be accepted and bearers will not be allowed to enter.
Ticket holders under 19 are not permitted to enter screenings rated “Restricted (19+),” even when accompanied by a guardian. Those who turn 19 during the calendar year are exempt.
Children under 4 are not allowed to enter even if they are accompanied by their guardian.
Alcoholic beverages or food purchased outside the Cinema are not allowed.
notes: Only bottled water is allowed in the Busan Cinema Center Haneulyeon Theatre, the KOFIC Theater, Sohyang Theatre Woori Bank Hall, and Busan Community Media Center Open Hall.

items.text: Changing seats during the screening is not allowed.  Please refrain from re-entering the theater once the screening has begun.
All photography and video recordings are strictly forbidden, including during the trailers and the ending credits.
notes: In the case of Guest Visits or other events held in the theater, you may take photos following guidance from staff.

lostAndFound: Lost items will be stored at the nearest BIFF Information Desk to where they were found.
If you have lost an item, please visit the nearest Information Desk or contact the Call Center.

Master Class : NA Hong-jin, A Genre of His Own
programs.bio: HOPE for the Competition section at this year’s Cannes marks a monumental moment in Korean cinema history. The overwhelming cinematic world of Na Hong-jin — impossible to define, impossible to predict. "Na Hong-jin" is, in itself, a remarkable genre. Let’s hear about the source of unparalleled creativity.

programs.title: Master Class : Lav DIAZ - Time and Memory
programs.bio: Meeting Korean audiences after about a decade, Lav Diaz has long engraved history's scars and human time onto the screen. This session explores his unique creative universe, inviting audiences into a candid conversation on cinema and cinematic time.

programs.title: Master Class : Rintaro, a Living Legend of Japanese Animation
programs.bio: A titan of Japanese animation, Rintaro shaped the medium's foundational visual language alongside Tezuka Osamu. This master class presents an exceptional occasion to gain insight into his iconic career and his enduring influence on generations of animators and film lovers worldwide.

programs.title: Master Class : Bertrand MANDICO, A Magician of Wild Cinema
programs.bio: Bertrand Mandico is a director who dissolves the line between reality and fantasy, conjuring grotesque, sensuous visuals into myths upon the screen. Having shattered the taboos of genre and gender with celluloid's texture and an imagination unbound by convention, he now shares, in his own words, the secrets behind his singular art — moderated by film critic Lee Yong-cheol.

programs.title: Master Class : The Cinematic Visions of Alfonso CUARÓN
programs.bio: Multiple Academy Award winner Alfonso Cuarón has continually redefined the medium of cinema with his revolutionary visual language and profound emotional depth. Joined by guest moderator Yeon Sang-ho, this master class presents an exceptional occasion to explore Cuarón’s iconic career and dive deep into his creative process.

programs.title: ZHANG Lu: Embracing the Unfamiliar World of The Other
programs.venue: Book Cafe Lounge, 4F, DSU-KIT Centum Campus
programs.bio: ZHANG Lu, winner of the Busan Award for Best Film at BIFF 2025 for Gloaming in Luomu (2025), who will share the world he explores and engages with through his cross-border filmmaking.

programs.title: Seifollah SAMADIAN: 30 Years with Abbas KIAROSTAMI as His Cinematographer and Friend
programs.venue: Book Cafe Lounge, 4F, DSU-KIT Centum Campus
programs.bio: To mark the 10th anniversary of Abbas Kiarostami’s passing this year, filmmaker Seifollah Samadian, Kiarostami’s cinematographer and longtime friend, will share with the audience his moving and humorous memories of Kiarostami’s films and life.

programs.title: Women, Rewriting the Screen : A Conversation with Judith GODRÈCHE
programs.venue: Book Cafe Lounge, 4F, DSU-KIT Centum Campus
programs.bio: Judith Godrèche, an actress-turned-director who has become an emblematic voice of France's #MeToo movement, arrives in Busan with her new film A Girl's Story , made together with her own daughter, Tess Barthélemy. Join this Cine Class for an intimate encounter with a filmmaker who has rewritten the screen through her own memory — and hear her thoughts, in her own voice.

programs.title: Billy ACUMEN: The Box-Office Producer′s Secret Behind The King’s Warden, The Outlaws, The Roundup Series
programs.venue: Book Cafe Lounge, 4F, DSU-KIT Centum Campus
programs.bio: Billy Acumen, the producer behind The King’s Warden (2026) and The Roundup (2017, 2022, 2023, 2024) series will share the secrets behind his box-office successes.

programs.title: BI Gan: On Making Strange and Beautiful Films
programs.venue: Book Cafe Lounge, 4F, DSU-KIT Centum Campus
programs.bio: From his debut feature Kaili Blues to Long Day’s Journey into Night and Resurrection , Bi Gan has created a singular and beautiful cinematic world where dreams, memories, and time intertwine. In this Ciné Class, we hear from Bi Gan about the cinema he dreams of and continues to create.

programs.title: SHIM Eun-kyoung: Transcending Borders, Discovering Craft
programs.venue: Book Cafe Lounge, 4F, DSU-KIT Centum Campus
programs.bio: Shim Eun-kyung shares what she has learned and achieved while pursuing a unique career path that takes her back and forth between South Korea and Japan.

programs.title: Charlotte GAINSBOURG: The Muse of French Chic
programs.bio: Timeless, unfading, effortlessly elegant — she is the very embodiment of French chic. Actress, musician, eternal muse to auteurs like Lars von Trier, Charlotte Gainsbourg has spent decades forging her own path across screen and song. In Busan, she opens up — quietly, deeply — about the years behind her, and the art of acting itself.

programs.title: Special Talk: The Cinematic Life of Ann Hui, Winner of the Camellia Award
